weapon.d:
For allies within 3 rows or 3 columns centered on unit, grants Atk/Spd+5 and neutralizes penalties during their combat.
If unit initiates combat or is within 2 spaces of an ally, grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+5 to unit, neutralizes penalties on unit, and deals +X damage during combat (max 15; excluding area-of-effect Specials; X = number of allies within 3 rows or 3 columns centered on unit × 5; calculates damage from staff after combat damage is added).

For allies within 3 rows or 3 columns centered on unit, grants Atk/Spd+5 and neutralizes penalties during their combat.
If unit initiates combat or is within 2 spaces of an ally, grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+5 to unit, neutralizes penalties on unit, and deals +X damage during combat (max 15; excluding area-of-effect Specials; X = number of allies within 3 rows or 3 columns centered on unit × 5; calculates damage from staff after combat damage is added).

assist.d:
Slows Special trigger (cooldown count+1).
Restores 15 HP to target ally.
Restores HP = 50% of Atk +10. (Minimum of 15 HP.)

special.d: When healing an ally with a staff, restores an additional 10 HP to target ally.
When healing an ally with a staff, grants Spd+4 to all allies for 1 turn.
When healing an ally with a staff, grants Spd/Res+4 to all allies for 1 turn.

a.d: If unit is within 2 spaces of an ally, grants Atk/Res+X to unit during combat (X = number of allies within 2 spaces; max 3).
If unit is within 2 spaces of an ally, grants Atk/Res+X to unit during combat (X = number of allies within 2 spaces + 2; max 5).
If unit is within 2 spaces of an ally, grants Atk/Res+X to unit during combat (X = 2 × number of allies within 2 spaces, + 1; max 7).

c.d: Grants Spd+2 to adjacent allies during combat.
Grants Spd+2 to allies within 2 spaces during combat.
Grants Spd+3 to allies within 2 spaces during combat.
